Beelzemon is an Evil King Digimon that prizes its
independence, despite having the ability to rule
over many Evil-species Digimon. One of the Seven
Great Demon Lords, Beelzemon is said to be capable
of becoming the foremost Nightmare Soldier should
it so desire, but it's also rumored that there's
another Evil King Digimon whose power surpasses
even Beelzemon's. Beelzemon always keeps its
beloved shotguns, the Berenjena, close at hand,
and it rides around on its giant motorcycle
machine Behemoth. It has a cruel and ruthless
personality, but due to its pride, it never
appears in groups or attacks the weak. Its
signature move is Darkness Claw, with which it
raises its sharp claws into the air and then
slices through its foe. Its special move, Double
Impact, involves firing twin blasts from its two
shotguns.
